notes.summary: Mensuration covers areas of 2D shapes and volumes / surface areas of 3D solids. 2–3 questions in Tier 1, 2–4 in Tier 2. Use π = 22/7 unless told otherwise.

concepts.title: 2D shapes
concepts.body:
• Circle: area πr2, circumference 2πr.
  • Triangle with sides a, b, c: area = √(s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)), s = (a + b + c)/2 (Heron).
  • Rectangle: area lb, diagonal √(l2 + b2).

concepts.title: 3D solids
concepts.body:
• Cube: volume a3, TSA 6a2.
  • Cylinder: volume πr2h, CSA 2πrh.
  • Cone: volume ⅓πr2h, CSA πrl.
  • Sphere: volume (4/3)πr3, surface 4πr2.

concepts.title: Melting and recasting
concepts.body: When a solid is melted and recast, the volume stays the same. Number of new pieces = big volume ÷ small volume.

varieties.name: Areas of plane figures
varieties.how: Pick the right formula; for paths, subtract inner area from outer area.

example.q: Area of a triangle with sides 5, 12, 13?

varieties.name: Volumes and recasting
varieties.how: Equate volumes before and after melting.

example.q: Volume of a cylinder with r = 7 cm, h = 4 cm?

varieties.name: Surface areas
varieties.how: CSA is the side only; TSA adds the top/bottom faces.

example.q: TSA of a cube of edge 5 cm?

tips: With π = 22/7, choose r as a multiple of 7 to cancel quickly.
A path of width w outside an l × b rectangle has area (l + 2w)(b + 2w) − lb.
traps: Do not confuse diameter with radius.
CSA of a cylinder does not include the two circular ends.

questions.q: What is the area of a circle of radius 7 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
What is the volume of a cube whose edge is 6 cm?
Find the area of a triangle whose sides are 13 cm, 14 cm and 15 cm.
Find the curved surface area of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm. (Take π = 22/7)
A solid metal sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into small cones, each of radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. How many cones are made?
questions.solution:
Volume of sphere = (4/3)π × 63 = 288π.
Volume of one cone = (1/3)π × 32 × 4 = 12π.
Number of cones = 288π / 12π = 24.

questions.q: A rectangular garden 40 m × 30 m has a path 2 m wide running all around it on the outside. What is the area of the path?

flashcards.back: √(s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)), s = half perimeter
